I am a full professor at [Corvinus University of Budapest](https://www.uni-corvinus.hu/?lang=en) and a part-time researcher at the [Centre for Economic and Regional Studies](https://kti.krtk.hu/en/).

My research focuses on macroeconomics, labor markets, income distribution and European economic adjustment.

I earned my PhD in Economics at Northwestern University in 2001. I previously held positions at Boston College, Magyar Nemzeti Bank (the central bank of Hungary) and at the University of Pécs. Between 2004-2024, I was an adjunct professor at Central European University.
